body:
GREG, 2026-11-19, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e), verbatim:
- #1616 (about 19:29Z, message 9ad7e2ba): „Absolutnie usunac ten test!!! + Kimi To jest tautologia. Zakaz tego typu testów” (about tests/source_file_size.rs, the 2,499-line limit that stopped the w-808a landing).
- #1617 (about 19:30Z, message 12d034fa): „Nie możemy mieć testów co sprawdzają kod zródłowy. To się zmienia!!!”
RULE (both projects):
- No test may pass or fail on the TEXT or SHAPE of the source code (line or byte counts, file, function or module counts, required phrases, module layout, grep-style scans of src) instead of observable behaviour.
- Remove existing ones. Do not split code mechanically to satisfy them. Do not replace them with another static gate.
- This extends the existing bans on text-pinning and implementation-mirroring tests.
- It does NOT affect source_id, the input identity that binds a test result to the exact source.
- Kimi::Consultant agrees the short portable wording and inventories and removes cases in both projects.
- Sync landing stays the priority. Only the file-size test is removed inside the 808a R25 candidate (w-0474dd241b14); the wider inventory is its own item.
